signatures.head: theorem kanQuillen_model_exists : ∃ m : ModelCategory SSet.{u}, @cofibrations SSet.{u} _ m.categoryWithCofibrations = MorphismProperty.monomorphisms SSet.{u} ∧ @fibrations SSet.{u} _ m.categoryWithFibrations = SSet.modelCategoryQuillen.J.{u}.rlp ∧ @weakEquivalences SSet.{u} _ m.categoryWithWeakEquivalences = SimplicialModelInputs.geometricWeakEquivalences.{u}
noncomputable def kanQuillenModel : ModelCategory SSet.{u} := Classical.choose kanQuillen_model_exists

lemma bousfieldLocalizationFunctor_preservesSmallColimits {C : SSet.{u + 1}} [Quasicategory C] (hC : IsPresentable C) {I : Type u} (edges : I → C _⦋1⦌) : PreservesSmallColimits (bousfieldLocalizationFunctor hC edges) := adjunction_preservesSmallColimits (bousfieldReflection hC edges).adjunction

lemma bousfieldLocalizationFunctor_isAccessible {C : SSet.{u + 1}} [Quasicategory C] (hC : IsPresentable C) {I : Type u} (edges : I → C _⦋1⦌) : IsAccessibleFunctor (bousfieldLocalizationFunctor hC edges) := ⟨Cardinal.aleph0, Cardinal.isRegular_aleph0, (bousfieldLocalizationFunctor_preservesSmallColimits hC edges).isKappaAccessibleFunctor _⟩
def sheafificationAdjunction [HasWeakSheafify J A] : presheafToSheaf J A ⊣ sheafToPresheaf J A := Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint _
theorem sheafificationAdjunction_unit_app (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ D) : (sheafificationAdjunction J D).unit.app P = toSheafify J P := rfl
noncomputable abbrev sheafification : (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ D) ⥤ Cᵒᵖ ⥤ D := presheafToSheaf J D ⋙ sheafToPresheaf J D

6.5.0.1.decision: ordinary sheafification と native 弱同値の局所化はあるが、Brown–Joyal–Jardine の local model structure の coherent nerve と Shv(X)∧ の比較はない。SSet の Kan–Quillen モデル圏だけは simplicial presheaf の local model instance でも空間値層化との比較でもない。
